episode.title: Vietnam: from ration coupons to boom (working title)
episode.narration: episodes/vietnam/narration.wav (42.64 s, final voice). Word timings: episodes/vietnam/words.json
episode.assembly: episodes/vietnam/act1.py stitches key.py + batch_01.py in shot order, takes durations and ALL sound cues from this file, mixes the narration. Builders never write CUES.
cast: the 'average citizen': non la conical hat, olive work shirt, black hair, medium jaw
non la hat, long dark wavy hair, cream blouse
black fringe, white shirt, no hat
state-store clerk: olive uniform, peaked olive cap (no badge), glasses, slick hair, strong jaw
assets: S-shaped silhouette: wide north, thin waist near 17N, bulging south coast, Mekong tip pointing SW; gold with shadow edge; optional 3 cracks
dome-top iron cage, ring on top, 7 bars, base rail, gold padlock with EMBARGO tag. RECURRING MOTIF: planted S12, carried to S15; it opens in a later act (Doi Moi)
cream paper, perforated grid of stubs (item + amount), 'RATION BOOK 1986', purple STATE STORE stamp
generic green note, guilloche ovals, value in corners, plain 'DONG'; NO portrait, seal or emblem; wither 0..1
burlap sack tied neck / blue-rimmed bowl / layered pork belly / red hurricane lantern with glass globe and wire guards
two-stone hand mill, grooves rotate with ang, push-pole; returns pole-end point for the hands
'RICE 1 kg' tag with a red price, optional running hose legs
generic globe with drifting green blobs
7 stacked grey stone blocks, plain 'USSR' lettering, no emblem; crumble 0..1
north Vietnam countryside: karst peaks, flooded paddy strips, coconut palms. Horizon y=400
keyword(), sticky(), dust(), arm_to(), coin(), calendar(), rubber_stamp()
episode.motifs: The country is a gold map object. It gets cracked (S11), caged (S12), propped by the USSR pillar (S14), then loses the prop (S15). Later acts: the cage unlocks (Doi Moi) and the map gets a glow. Never reuse a metaphor within the act: grinding mill (S05) and running price tag (S09) are used once.

People 0-6 use expr 'sad' once the zone edge has passed their x, else 'neutral'. Counter: text(ctx, f'{n}%', 640, 95, 84, outline=INK), n = int(70*clamp((t-0.30)/0.56)), shown from 0.30.

shots.narration: Inflation was running at a staggering 587%,
shots.visual: Metaphor: a rice price tag with legs runs up a steep jagged price line that draws itself. Its price climbs fast. On '587%' a huge '587%' slams in with a camera shake.
shots.staging: bg_dark(ctx). Price line: a jagged polyline from (120,600) to (1120,140) with 9 points (alternating small dips), drawn progressively from 0.40 to 1.98 (k = clamp((t-0.4)/1.58)): line(ctx,pts_up_to_k,RED,9) over line(ctx,...,INK,15). Tag: price_tag(ctx,tip_x-40,tip_y-90,0.8,value=str(int(lerp(100,687,k))),walk=t*3.2) running on the line's tip from 0.68. Before 0.68 the tag stands still at the start (walk=None). After 1.98 the tag holds at the top. Keyword '587%' at (430,210) size 84 popped at 1.98. Shake: camera(...,shake=0.6*(1-(t-1.98)/0.4)) for 1.98-2.38 only.
shots.camera: push_in 1.00-1.10 centred (700,320), plus a shake at 1.98-2.38
checks: the line draws progressively and the tag stays on its tip (feet on the line)
the legs animate only while running (0.68-1.98)
'587%' appears at 1.98 +-0.1 s; the shake lasts 0.4 s or less
